title: Report
description: Business report document containing analysis, metrics, or summaries. Tracks report metadata, creator, department, reporting period, status, and file location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the report record

title.description: Title or name of the report

type.description: Type or category of report (e.g., financial, sales, performance, audit, quarterly)

description.description: Summary or overview of what the report contains and its purpose

created_by.description: Full name of the person who authored or created the report

department.description: Department or division that generated or owns this report

period_start.description: Start date of the reporting period covered by this report

period_end.description: End date of the reporting period covered by this report

status.description: Current status of the report (e.g., draft, final, published, archived)

file_url.description: URL or file path where the report document is stored (PDF, Excel, etc.)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the report was created
